occurrences.pixelObservations: Upper center, immediately left of 3+ and above THE SUPPLY ROUTE: a small round white head sits above a bilaterally widened white torso with lateral shoulder/arm lobes and a divided lower contour. Two to three low concentric cyan and electric-blue ovals surround the base, with dark navy gaps between their rims. The enlarged official detail repeats this composite. The glossary candidate visibly has a round white helmet/head, dark visor gap, symmetric torso, paired arms, and divided legs on a dark field.
occurrences.closestAlternative: A rounded beacon or flame-like vertical mark rising above ripple-like ovals.
occurrences.visibleDiscriminator: The white central mark has a distinct round head above bilateral shoulder/arm lobes and a divided lower body; a beacon or flame would be a continuous axial form and ordinarily taper toward its apex rather than form paired limbs.
occurrences.uncertainty: The source highlight is bloom-softened and suppresses internal visor and torso divisions. The displayed glossary heading is right-clipped after the visible text GLOSSARY general/ch, but the round-headed bilateral figure morphology remains visible.

occurrences.pixelObservations: Upper-left red placard below CARGO-045: two separate, horizontally elongated pale-yellow and cream rounded blocks occupy one row. The right block contains a red/dark-red triangular interruption and adjoins a small cream wedge terminating in an acute right-facing point; no character is legible.
occurrences.closestAlternative: An independent arrow or chevron control following two blank rectangular fields.
occurrences.visibleDiscriminator: The pointed element is attached to the right rounded block and aligned with the placard's other field-like graphics, rather than appearing as a separately enclosed or repeated glyph.

occurrences.pixelObservations: Mirrored along the left and right edges of the large lower text panel: black and charcoal beveled border housings contain two or three short, parallel diagonal orange strokes with thin cream highlights. The clusters reverse orientation across the panel and contain no lettering.
occurrences.visibleDiscriminator: Each cluster is physically continuous with the beveled panel outline and is bilaterally mirrored at the opposing edge, rather than isolated in its own enclosure as an operative symbol.
